subtasks.title: Remove the tier-1 continuous-GPS call path from KitUserPathController so kit_scan_paths is the sole path source
subtasks.approach: Delete tier-1 orchestration from paths() and collapse every branch that existed only to reconcile two tiers. Tier 2 (KitScanPathsQuery -> clarity.kit_scan_paths) becomes the only source, for all kits, all orgs. PRESERVE KitRangePathsQuery and its unit suite untouched — ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController still calls the class and Bird's Eye is deliberately left on continuous GPS. TDD: rewrite the controller test first (delete the tier-1 pins, add a pin that sc_positions is never queried), confirm red, then make it green.

COLLAPSE the unavailable branch to an unconditional 503 (tier 2 IS the whole response now)

KEEP MAX_RENDER_POINTS (tier 2 is now its sole consumer) and update its docblock: it no longer sums across two tiers

sizing_gate: PASS — 2 files, one cohesive concern (remove tier 1 from this one endpoint). No split recommended.
perf_gate: NOT REQUIRED — the change REMOVES the sc_positions read rather than adding one, and the surviving surface (clarity.kit_scan_paths, measured 1.66M rows fleet-wide) is nowhere near the >1B-row threshold. Relevant cardinality was already measured during prep.
blast_radius_review: No target file matches the sensitive globs (database/migrations/**, billing, Shield/Policies/auth, Clickhouse*Purge|Cleanup, PruneScans). No human pre-approval required beyond the Phase 2 gate answers already given.
risks: 617 kits (30d) lose continuous routing. ACCEPTED and global per Dalton's Q1/Q3 answers. This is a visible fidelity regression, not a silent one.

The over_budget and unavailable branches carried real tier-1-degradation semantics. Collapsing them must not turn a recoverable partial render into a hard error for a case that used to succeed — the surviving tier-2 422/503 semantics need explicit test pins.

Deleting tier-1 orchestration removes the only ->utc() mutation of $start/$end. Any code below that assumed UTC-mutated values would silently change meaning. Verified: only $localStart/$localEnd are consumed downstream and they are captured pre-mutation, so this is safe — but the worker must not 'tidy' that capture away.
DEV-2450 must now rebuild the tier-1 wiring rather than flip a flag. Stated to Dalton and accepted.
